chapter: Other pianists and the New Orleans scene
title: Isidore Washington and jam sessions
summary: She knows Isidore Washington as a good player by ear; she never liked jam sessions or cutting contests.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did you ever go around and hear Red Caillou or Toots or any of those people that were playing at parties?
No, I don't know Red Caillou.
Oh, yes. Uh-huh. Yes, oh yes, he plays well.
I just wondered if, you know, he's told me about going to jam sessions, you know, that have the cutting contest between the two and the piano.
Well, he liked that, but I didn't like that. He didn't go around. I never did like jam sessions. But he plays by ear. Yes, he plays well by ear.
